newsitem.title: USA: Commodore Environmental unit files IPO.
newsitem.headline: Commodore Environmental unit files IPO.

text.p: Commodore Environmental Services Inc said Thursday its subsidiary, Commodore Separation Technologies Inc, has filed a registration statement with the Securities and Exchange Commission relating to a proposed underwritten initial public offering of 5,000,000 shares of common stock and 5,000,000 common stock purchase warrants.
The company said the offering should begin in October, and Commodore Environmental Services would own 75 percent of Commodore Separation Technologies after the offering.
